purpose: Test whether the three archive-supported US equity information/tail families survive an exact point-in-time stock-level reconstruction without opening an unbounded formula search.

candidate_family_frozen.formula: negative standardized 30D 50-delta put-minus-call implied-volatility smile slope
equal-weight standardized combination of SmileSlope and AnnouncementReturn using only values available at decision time
equal-weight standardized combination of SmileSlope, AnalystRevision, AnnouncementReturn and DivYieldST using only values available at decision time

forbidden_after_freeze: adding candidates after reading validation or lockbox outcomes
changing signs, horizons, weighting, winsorization, breakpoints or universe filters after outcomes
using current constituents for historical dates
dropping delisted securities or assigning missing delisting return to zero
using filing period end, earnings quarter end or analyst revision date before actual dissemination availability
using end-of-day option surface values for a trade timestamp before those values existed
promoting aggregate factor evidence into ticker permission
relaxing a gate because a candidate narrowly failed

universe.option_surface_minimum: valid 30D interpolation with crossed/stale quote removal and documented delta convention

time_splits.prospective_watch_start: first lawful complete snapshot after implementation
time_splits.lockbox_open_rule: all code, data hashes, exclusions, costs and candidate family frozen before opening

inference.primary_test: monthly alpha versus market, size, value, profitability, investment and momentum controls

promotion_rule: All validation, lockbox, costs, capacity, calibration and prospective gates must pass for the exact component and exact scope. Partial success stays zero-capital.
failed_candidate_policy: Remove from decision-active production. Preserve receipt and negative result in the global trial ledger.
claim_ceiling: Even a pass only supports the exact tested US monthly long-short scope; it does not prove IHSG, FX, commodities, crypto, daily timing, target prices or leverage.
